podcast.title: Relationship with Norah Jones
podcast.body: Through her reunion with her father, Norah Jones finally got to know her half-sister, Anoushka Shankar, allowing Norah to connect with her "Indian side." "And I got to know my sister, finally my half sister, Anushka Shankar and I did kind of finally get to know my Indian side a little bit, you know, which was a really beautiful new thing for me."
